references.text: Parallel text confirming that the Benjaminites also did not drive out the Jebusites from Jerusalem, and that the Jebusites continued to live there.
Describes how the Jebusites controlled Jerusalem before David captured the city.
David finally conquers Jerusalem from the Jebusites and makes it his capital, showing the fulfillment of what remained undone in Joshua's time.
Parallel account of David's conquest of Jerusalem from the Jebusites.
The Jebusites are mentioned among the Canaanite peoples living in the land.
God's promise to bring the Israelites into a land where the Jebusites lived.
The spies' report mentions that the Jebusites lived in the mountains, including the Jerusalem area.
